name: American Honda - Chino Parts Distribution Center (NA Hub West) - Chino CA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Wide chain-link rolling/sliding gate across the truck-court driveway off the east frontage road - a controlled truck entrance. Confirmed in Street View 2025-10; trailer court visible behind the gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the truck gate in Street View - the gate appears to be a remote/badge-operated sliding gate. The east and south perimeter are hedge-screened so a small booth cannot be 100% excluded, hence flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true because there is a truck gate but no visible guard shack, implying badge/kiosk/remote check-in - moderate confidence.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved truck court inside the fence between the gate and the dock doors provides ample inside queuing.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved truck court inside the gate easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated 1 - shares the single gated driveway.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks on the east face (into the large trailer court) and the south/SW face; building is the 500,000 sq ft NA Hub West with heavy trailer activity - door total estimated ~55, in the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dedicated trailer-storage court on the east/south of the building packed with parked trailers and stacked intermodal containers - well over 50 stalls.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock clusters on different building faces (east face and south/SW face).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Chino/Inland Empire industrial fabric, fully surrounded by warehouses and city development - Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: One Honda PDC building on this property; the large warehouse immediately south is a separate (non-Honda) building, not counted.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated on-site trailer-storage court, separate from active dock staging - many parked trailers and containers.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimate from the east/south trailer court - approximate.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (34.012023,-117.678685, APPROXIMATE) landed in a Chino residential neighborhood. Resolved to 14141 Yorba Ave via web research; satellite/Street View confirmed the large solar-roofed PDC building with Honda-colored trailers.
